off.title: Turn off {{name}}?
off.description: People can't sign in with their password from {{host}} until you turn it back on. Their accounts stay as they are.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: People can no longer sign in with their password from {{host}}. Their accounts, groups and roles stay; anyone who signs in only this way needs another way in. Its sync history stays in Activity.

revoke.title: Revoke the SCIM token?
revoke.description_one: Your identity provider can no longer send changes here: new people, updates and suspensions stop until you give it a new token. The {{n}} person it created stays as they are.
revoke.description_other: Your identity provider can no longer send changes here: new people, updates and suspensions stop until you give it a new token. The {{n}} people it created stay as they are.
